name: Availity
short_description: Availity is a free healthcare network portal offering real-time eligibility verification, claims submission, and payer connectivity.
long_description: Availity is a multi-payer healthcare information network that provides free eligibility verification, claims submission, and prior authorization services. The platform connects providers with hundreds of health plans through a single portal. Core features are free for providers, including real-time eligibility checks and claims submission to participating payers. Availity also offers premium add-on services for practices needing advanced revenue cycle management. The platform is widely used by solo practitioners and small practices seeking cost-effective billing solutions.
one_liner: Free multi-payer portal for eligibility verification and claims submission.
best_for: Solo and small practices needing free eligibility verification
Providers billing commercial payers seeking cost-effective solutions
Multi-specialty groups needing comprehensive payer connectivity
Practices wanting free claims submission to participating payers
